Sale.title: Sale
Sale.description: Recorded sales transaction item in the sales ledger (cash, card, traded out, or online)

paymentMethod.description: Payment method used for sales ledger transaction

isMiscellaneous.description: Whether item is a miscellaneous sale

dateKey.description: Calendar date string in YYYY-MM-DD format

isOnlineSale.description: Whether this sale came from scanning an online inventory card

onlineCardId.description: ID of the associated online card

onlineBarcode.description: Barcode number of the associated online card

Vendor.title: Vendor
Vendor.description: Registered active vendor in the team roster

color.description: Assigned theme color hex code for the vendor

Trade.title: Trade
Trade.description: Recorded trade-in transaction: cards traded in for cash or for credit (vendors credit)

itemDescription.description: Description of the cards or items traded in

tradeValue.description: Agreed valuation in GBP of the traded cards

tradeType.description: Compensation method: cards traded in for cash or for credit (vendors credit)

customerName.description: Optional customer name trading in cards

notes.description: Optional notes or terms regarding the trade

OnlineCard.title: OnlineCard
OnlineCard.description: Online card with barcode, vendor attribution, name, price, status and sales tracking

cardName.description: Name or title of the card

soldAt.description: Timestamp when sold via barcode scanner

saleId.description: ID of the sale record in the sales ledger

/sales/{saleId}.description: Collection of all sales ledger records (cash, card, traded out, or online) across terminals

/salesmen/{salesmanId}.description: Collection of team vendors roster across terminals

/trades/{tradeId}.description: Collection of trade-in records (cards traded in for cash or credit) across terminals

/online_cards/{cardId}.description: Collection of online cards and barcodes synced in real-time across all devices
